listing.title: Teacher Mug, Watercolor Apples and Pencils All Over Print Coffee Mug, School Supplies Mug, Teacher Christmas Gift, Teacher Appreciation
listing.description: Watercolor apples in red and green, sharpened pencils in sunny yellow and bright colors, wax crayons, stacks of hardcover books, wooden rulers, paper airplanes, a painter's palette with its brush and little gold stars fill the whole mug on a warm cream background. There's no slogan or name, so it works as a thank-you from any family: at Christmas, for Teacher Appreciation Week or at the end of the school year.

listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-11-16: web searches '"Apples and Pencils" OR "Apples & Pencils" trademark brand mugs teacher' and '"Watercolor Classroom" trademark OR brand mug' found no brand, shop or mark by either name (the results were generic apple-and-pencil teacher mugs from Hallmark, Our Name is Mud/Enesco, Personalization Mall and others). The art has no lettering; 'teacher', 'apples', 'pencils', 'crayon' and 'school supplies' describe the gift and what is pictured. Rifle Paper Co. sells a 'Pencils' porcelain mug: this art is a mixed watercolor classroom pattern, not a pencil repeat. tmsearch.uspto.gov is blocked from our sessions; this is a search-engine screen, not a clearance.
